scenes.heading: Time Travel
scenes.subheading: Query past versions of a table
scenes.narration: Delta time travel lets you query a table as it existed at an earlier version or timestamp, using the transaction log.

scenes.heading: What it enables
bullets: Audit how data changed over time
scenes.narration: Time travel lets you audit exactly how a table changed across versions. It gives you a fast way to recover from an accidental update by reading a prior state. And it lets you reproduce a report precisely as the data looked on a given day.

scenes.heading: Reading and restoring versions
scenes.narration: The VERSION AS OF clause returns the table exactly as it was at that commit. You can also travel by timestamp when you know the wall-clock moment. And RESTORE rolls the live table back to a chosen good version when an update went wrong.

scenes.text: Time travel only reaches back as far as your retained history, so VACUUM settings determine how far you can go.
